tagline: Pick real photos for your pages from a gallery, not a guess
use_when: An article or page needs photos and you want to choose from real, properly licensed candidates instead of having one picked and dropped in for you.
promises: Every candidate checked by eye first
Nothing is added until you pick it
try_it: Use the photo-picker skill to find two or three photo options for each section of my /articles/herb-garden page.

features.label: Spots That Need a Photo
features.sub: Each place on the page that needs a picture is a slot
features.title: Each place on the page that needs a picture is a slot
features.what: The page is broken into slots, one per spot that needs a photo, each with a note on what it should illustrate. You decide slot by slot instead of all or nothing.
features.html:

features.label: Real Photos, Not Guesses
features.sub: Real, properly licensed candidates for every slot
features.title: Real, properly licensed candidates for every slot
features.what: Candidates are real photographs from free-license stock libraries, or official cover images for books. You choose between actual images, not descriptions of them.
features.html:
A · stock
B · stock

features.label: Checked by Eye First
features.sub: Every candidate is opened and looked at before you see it
features.title: Every candidate is opened and looked at before you see it
features.what: Each image is downloaded and looked at before it is offered: the right subject, the right book edition, the right orientation, not a broken placeholder. A link that loads is not taken as proof.
features.html:
Option A
right subject right orientation not a placeholder

features.label: Where It Came From
features.sub: Every candidate shows its source and license
features.title: Every candidate shows its source and license
features.what: Each card notes where the image came from and why it fits. You know what you are allowed to use before you pick it.
features.html:

free license

features.label: Reuse What You Have
features.sub: Photos already on your site are offered first
features.title: Photos already on your site are offered first
features.what: If your site already has a photo of the same subject, it is offered as a candidate with an Already on site badge. Pages stay consistent and you avoid two different photos of the same thing.
features.html:
Option AAlready on site
Option BNew · stock

features.label: Only Real Contenders
features.sub: One to three options, never padded
features.title: One to three options, never padded
features.what: Most slots get one to three candidates. If only one image truly fits, you see just that one rather than filler added to make a set.
features.html:
Only option
one real match · no filler

features.label: Your Site's Look
features.sub: The gallery uses your page's own fonts and colors
features.title: The gallery uses your page's own fonts and colors
features.what: The review page borrows the palette and type of the page the photos are for, so you judge each photo in a setting close to where it will live.
features.html:
Photo picker · your look

features.label: Click to Pick
features.sub: Click a photo to select it
features.title: Click a photo to select it
features.what: Clicking a card selects it with a border, and the decision buttons apply to whichever photo is selected.

features.label: Four Clear Choices
features.sub: Keep none, use it, use it with changes, or search again
features.title: Keep none, use it, use it with changes, or search again
features.what: Each slot has Keep None, Use Selected, Approve with Comment and Request Revision. That covers no photo here, this photo as is, this photo adjusted, or none of these.
features.html: Keep NoneUse SelectedApprove with CommentRequest Revision

features.label: Say How to Use It
features.sub: Ask for a crop, caption or different placement
features.title: Ask for a crop, caption or different placement
features.what: Approve with Comment opens a box for how the photo should be used, like a tighter crop, a caption or a different position on the page.
features.html:
Approve with Comment
crop tighter, add a caption

features.label: Search Again
features.sub: None of these? Say what to look for instead
features.title: None of these? Say what to look for instead
features.what: Request Revision means start over for that slot, in a different direction. Your comment says what to try: another subject, mood or source.
features.html:
Request Revision
too staged, try something outdoors

features.label: Readable in Both Themes
features.sub: Comment boxes and status colors work in light and dark
features.title: Comment boxes and status colors work in light and dark
features.what: Every status color has its own dark-mode version, so your own notes stay readable whichever theme your device uses.

features.label: Always Know Where You Are
features.sub: A progress bar stays in view as you go
features.title: A progress bar stays in view as you go
features.what: A bar pinned to the bottom shows how many slots you've reviewed and a count for each decision.

features.sub: Copy My Decisions sends every pick to Claude
features.title: Copy My Decisions sends every pick to Claude
features.what: One button copies a plain summary headed with the gallery's name, listing each slot's decision, chosen option and comments. You paste it into chat and it can't be confused with another review.

features.label: Uploaded to Your Image Host
features.sub: The chosen photo goes to your image host and onto the page
features.title: The chosen photo is uploaded and placed on the page
features.what: Each accepted photo is uploaded to your image host, following the folder and naming your project notes describe, and its address is wired into the page at the right spot. If the project has no image host yet, Claude asks where images should live before uploading anything.

features.sub: Crops, captions and alt text from your comments
features.title: Crops, captions and alt text from your comments
features.what: If you approved with a comment, the photo is adjusted before it goes in: cropped, captioned, given alt text or moved, as you asked.

features.sub: Nothing else on the page gets touched
features.title: Nothing else on the page gets touched
features.what: Only accepted slots get a photo. Kept-empty slots stay empty and slots sent back for another search are left alone until the next round.

features.label: Where the Page Goes
features.sub: A private link, a local file, or your Wi-Fi
features.title: A private link, a local file, or your Wi-Fi
features.what: Your project picks where review pages go: a private claude.ai link, an HTML file that opens in your browser, or that file served on your home Wi-Fi so a phone can open it. Nothing is ever uploaded or tunneled in the Wi-Fi mode, and the server stops when the review ends.
